C1137.title: OKX Restricts Coin Mixer Transactions
C1137.summary: In September 2024, cryptocurrency exchange OKX announced strict restrictions on users engaging with coin mixers, warning that involved accounts may face freezing or closure. The move responds to global regulatory demands to combat money laundering through transaction obfuscation.

references.title: Web3 Lawyer: Who Would a Serious Person Use a Cryptocurrency Mixer?
